name: neon-arcade-red-hot-blonde
image_vibe: Energetic playful neon arcade, saturated red and pink, candid nightlife
image_purpose: Create a vibrant social lifestyle portrait in an indoor amusement arcade.

prompt.project_info: A medium photorealistic portrait of an original adult woman seated on an electric fuchsia arcade motorcycle game.
prompt.main_subject: An original adult woman with long wavy blonde hair and a radiant joyful wide smile, seated on the arcade motorcycle with hands on the handlebars, leaning slightly forward and turning her head toward the camera. She wears a strapless red knit crop top with distressed texture and buckle strap, matching tight white latex shorts, and a visible white waistband with supplied black lettering.
prompt.composition_elements: Medium profile-angled shot, subject and arcade motorcycle clearly readable, yellow SUPER KEOR BIKES racing cabinet in the foreground, other arcade machines and neon signage blurred behind, and crisp playful visual hierarchy.
prompt.lighting_and_atmosphere: Vibrant high-contrast arcade lighting, orange LED strips outlining machines, cool electric-blue ambient light, saturated red/pink wardrobe, and deep shadows.
prompt.technical_specs: Photorealistic smartphone/editorial portrait, medium framing, sharp subject focus, shallow background depth, realistic knit, latex, skin, machine, and neon texture, no unintended text or watermark.
prompt.generated_prompt_string: Create a vibrant photorealistic medium portrait of an original adult woman with long wavy blonde hair and a radiant joyful wide smile, seated on an electric fuchsia arcade motorcycle game with hands on the handlebars, leaning slightly forward and turning in profile to face camera. She wears a strapless red knit crop top with distressed ripped texture and a decorative buckle strap across the chest, matching tight white latex shorts, and a visible white waistband with supplied black lettering. Place her in an indoor amusement arcade with a bright electric-yellow SUPER KEOR BIKES racing cabinet in the foreground, blurred arcade machines and neon signs behind, orange LED strips, cool electric-blue ambient light, saturated red and pink tones, high contrast, sharp subject focus, and playful nightlife energy.
prompt.negative_prompt: explicit, nsfw, overly revealing, minor or teen-coded subject, transparent clothing, exposed underwear, nudity, sexualized pose, celebrity likeness, distorted motorcycle, warped supplied lettering, plastic skin, waxy, over-smooth, airbrushed, HDR look, watermark, unintended text, extra fingers, deformed

Keep text limited to source-specified supplied signage and avoid unrelated logos.
